statement_map.email_excerpt: Thank you for your time on our call, and I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused.
You came to us because some of your students say the lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and you hope it gets sorted out.
We opened the lesson link you shared on a desktop in Chrome, in Safari and on a phone, and the video played each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side.
Ask one of your students to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.
We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
We could not give a timeline during the call, so we are not able to say when yet.
